name: cineinsight-media-grabber
description: 抓取网页流式媒体（HLS/TS/直链）的 Chrome/Edge MV3 扩展，可选推送到 CineInsight 桌面端

scripts.package: rm -f ../build/bin/cineinsight-media-grabber-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r -q ../build/bin/cineinsight-media-grabber-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json src icons vendor README.md -x 'icons/make-icons.py' && echo packaged: build/bin/cineinsight-media-grabber-$npm_package_version.zip
